title: Designing a URL shortener

steps.text: A URL shortener turns a long link into a short code. It must create a short link, redirect fast, and handle about a hundred million new links a month.

Compare three ways to make the code in a table. A base 62 counter is easy to guess but never collides. A random code is hard to guess but needs a collision check. A hash of the URL is hard to guess and also needs a collision check.

## Pitfalls
- A sequential counter makes codes easy to guess.
- A random code needs a collision check when it is saved.
